title: VaaniFill API Contract Spec
description: Standardized request and response structures agreed upon by Frontend, Backend, and Extension teams.

extractVoice.description: Universal voice speech extraction and conversational follow-up for Chrome extension and Web App

body.transcript: string (spoken user transcript in Hindi, English, or Hinglish)
body.fields: array of { id, label, type, required } detected on the webpage DOM
body.current_values: object containing previously extracted key-value pairs

body.values: object with key-value pairs of extracted fields
body.missing_fields: array of field IDs that are required but still unmentioned
body.validation_errors: object of { [fieldId]: errorMessage } for format mistakes
body.follow_up_question: string with natural next question in user language
body.reply: string with assistant conversational response message

uploadDocument.description: Upload any form image or PDF for zero-shot layout OCR and field detection

matchFormFields.description: Match extracted values with user profile or voice responses

generatePdf.description: Generate an official stamped PDF application from confirmed field values
